title: An Interface to the AutoDesk API Platform
text: AutoDeskR R package provides interface : Authentication API — obtain OAuth2 tokens expiry tracking via aps_token class. Data Management API — manage buckets objects across platform’s cloud services. Design Automation API — run automated tasks design files cloud. Model Derivative API — translate design files SVF, SVF2, OBJ, STL formats extract model data. Reality Capture API — generate 3D models photogrammetry image sets. Viewer — render 2D 3D models Shiny applications. MCP Tools — expose AutoDeskR functions AI models via Model Context Protocol using ellmer mcptools. Learn Companion Book.

title: An Interface to the AutoDesk API Platform
code: library(AutoDeskR)  # 1. Authenticate tok <- getToken(id = Sys.getenv("APS_CLIENT_ID"), secret = Sys.getenv("APS_CLIENT_SECRET")) is_expired(tok)  # FALSE  # 2. Upload a file makeBucket(token = tok, bucket = "mybucket") uploadFile(file = "aerial.dwg", token = tok, bucket = "mybucket")  # 3. Translate and wait resp <- translateSvf2(urn = myEncodedUrn, token = tok) done <- waitForFile(urn = myEncodedUrn, token = tok)  # 4. Tidy output (requires tibble) library(tibble) listBuckets(token = tok) |> as_tibble()

title: An Interface to the AutoDesk API Platform
text: AutoDeskR exposes functions AI models via Model Context Protocol (MCP). Use autodeskr_mcp_tools() start MCP server AI assistants can call directly — token argument required; credentials read APS_CLIENT_ID APS_CLIENT_SECRET environment variables. server exposes tools five APIs: Authentication, Data Management, Model Derivative, Design Automation, Reality Capture.
code: # Requires the ellmer and mcptools packages install.packages(c("ellmer", "mcptools"))  Sys.setenv(APS_CLIENT_ID = "your_id", APS_CLIENT_SECRET = "your_secret") tools <- autodeskr_mcp_tools() mcptools::mcp_server(tools = tools)

text: pkgdown site added deployed GitHub Pages https://paulgovan.github.io/AutoDeskR/ via new GitHub Actions workflow. inst/CITATION updated reference current companion book https://paulgovan.github.io/AutoDeskR-Book/. ellmer mcptools added Suggests.

title: AutoDeskR 0.4.0
text: translateSvf2() — translate design files SVF2 format (~30% smaller SVF, faster rendering Viewer). createPhotoscene(), uploadImages(), processPhotoscene(), checkPhotoscene() — Reality Capture API photogrammetry 3D model generation images. waitForFile() — poll checkFile() Model Derivative translation completes. waitForWorkItem() — poll checkPdf() Design Automation WorkItem completes. is_expired() — check whether aps_token expired. aps_error() — structured S3 error condition APS API failures; catch tryCatch(..., aps_error = function(e) ...).

title: AutoDeskR 0.4.0
text: getToken() now returns aps_token object expiry tracking ($expires_at, is_expired()). Existing code using resp$content$access_token continues work unchanged. API functions now accept aps_token object place raw token string. Expired tokens trigger warning. API errors now include decoded JSON messages APS rather raw HTTP error text. as_tibble() methods added listBuckets listObjects response objects (requires tibble package).

title: AutoDeskR 0.4.0
text: Minimum R version bumped 2.10.0 4.1.0. tibble added Suggests.

title: AutoDeskR 0.3.0
text: Fixed <- arrow-assignment bugs getData(), getObjectTree(), translateObj(), translateStl(), getOutputUrn() roxygen examples. Fixed unreachable vr template branch viewerUI().

title: AutoDeskR 0.3.0
text: Updated viewer CDN URLs deprecated viewingservice/v1/viewers/ modelderivative/v2/viewers/7.*. Templates also modernized use Autodesk.Viewing.GuiViewer3D Document.load() (v7 API). Added req_timeout(60) API requests. Updated remaining “AutoDesk Forge” terminology “AutoDesk Platform Services (APS)” across README, vignettes, HTML templates.

title: AutoDeskR 0.3.0
text: uploadFileSigned() — signed S3 URL upload supporting files size.

title: AutoDeskR 0.3.0
text: Added Config/testthat/edition: 3 testthat 3rd-edition behavior. Added print() S3 methods 18 response classes. Expanded test coverage: NULL-token guards functions, DELETE mock fixtures, downloadFile JSON response path.

title: AutoDeskR 0.2.0
text: checkPdf(): source destination parameters now deprecated. Pass WorkItem id (makePdf()$content$id) new id parameter instead. Using old parameters issues deprecation warning.

title: AutoDeskR 0.2.0
text: Migrated HTTP backend httr httr2. HTTP errors now raise R errors rather warnings. Authentication updated deprecated v1 endpoint (/authentication/v1/authenticate, end--life May 2024) v2 endpoint (/authentication/v2/token). Design Automation API updated retired AutoCAD.io v2 endpoint Design Automation v3 API (/da/us-east/v3/workitems). downloadFile(): Added optional destfile parameter correct handling binary (non-JSON) responses. Bug fix: viewerUI() viewerType validation logic always evaluating TRUE; corrected properly reject invalid types.

title: AutoDeskR 0.2.0
text: listBuckets() — list app-managed buckets. deleteBucket() — delete app-managed bucket. listObjects() — list objects stored bucket. deleteObject() — delete object bucket. translateStl() — translate design file STL format.
